d.description: HMAC(k_g, UTF-8 bytes of the genesis digest G), or a random 32-byte filler encoded like a MAC

c.description: AES-256-GCM under k_e(G), AAD = the bytes of d, of the canonical bytes of a group-pair@1, encoded u + unpadded base64url of nonce (12) || ciphertext || tag (16); or filler: random bytes of exactly that length

title: RLTP group-star@1 (rltp-visibility@0.30)
description: The sender's groups, blinded to every contact, sealed to the chosen ones (Network Visibility 5.2b): one chunk of a group-star delivery on the relationship channel, carried by the task group-star/0.1. Entries are {d, c} of fixed size, padded to the next positive multiple of 16 (the all-filler star has 16), at most 64 per chunk, sorted by d once and sliced under the 5.2a rules with the group star's own salt, seq and last.
